// Notes: These settings wire the Assert.IQ Agent Pack into VS Code + Copilot.
Setting names may vary slightly across VS Code / Copilot versions; adjust as needed.
The intent is: load instruction files automatically, and look for prompt files
chat.hookFilesLocations points VS Code at the SAME .claude/settings.json that
Claude Code reads natively, so Dreaming session events (SessionStart/Stop) fire
in BOTH harnesses from one file. Its baked ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-<workspace>}
fallback resolves the pack root under Copilot, which does not set that env var.
